entry_points.text: Stack dump entry bypasses cross-CPU sync in panic; lock-debug disable attempts one-way transition and raises verbosity unless silent.
Boot options toggle tracking before init; early readies exclusions and reserve, late validates, creates cache, migrates and arms background handling.
Statistics appear as read-only file when enabled, inert without filesystem support.
Bzip2 driver accepts image or fill callback with destination or flush callback, decodes incrementally, validates integrity and reports status.

exports.text: Tagged context line reports CPU, credentials, command, taint, release and build identity with optional verbose, hardware and scheduler details.
Boot mask allocation with cache alignment plus NUMA spread and distributing any-CPU selectors returning CPU number or out-of-range sentinel.

Address-keyed tracking covers normal and stack init, activation, deactivation, destruction, freeing, init assertion and marker advance; disabled state is silent, init and idle may activate, active may idle or destroy, removal clears non-active.
Freed-range validation is enable-gated plus early hash and reserve setup, late cache creation with static migration, and optional read-only statistics.
Plain and raw lock helpers with normal and interrupt-preserving forms decrement counter, acquiring only toward zero and reporting ownership at zero.
Detector matches leading bytes against boot table returning routine or absence with label; malloc has early bump variant and kernel alias.

hazards.text: Allocation failure under bucket lock disables tracking globally then drains all buckets; later printers suppress output once disabled.
Diagnostics and recovery run unlocked and may reenter tracking; range handling unlinks idle and restarts bucket after active; warnings capped.
Slab batch links via shared tail with zeroing; mid-batch failure discards partial batch; lifetime allocation and release totals tracked.
Bit reader returns zero on failure indistinguishable from data; bump allocator aligns, never reclaims, aborts past limit and is not thread-safe.

invariants.text: Dump emits summary then architecture trace; spread folds index into online count with warning, distributors advance per-CPU cursor with wrap.
Global pool starts quarter low and full high with full minima; hash and boot arrays statically sized; batch moves shift one unit with ceiling checks.
Per-CPU alloc needs interrupts disabled, refills opportunistically near full and on exhaustion; background fill recycles deferred then allocates fresh.
Static check delegates to descriptor with stack verification and refusal for non-static assert and activate; test binds selftest to four recovery callbacks.
Bucket index shifts address by chunk width then hashes; lookup counts chain; range scan tallies and arms deferred work; stats clamp per-CPU counts.
Selftest verifies state and counters per phase; static entries migrate to dynamic batches; late setup scales reserves and offline drains to shared path.
Bit reservoir preserves order with sticky error latch; framing rejects legacy variant and bounds capacity; tables enforce group and length limits.
Per-block checksums fold into running total with mismatch escalation; staging is on-demand with failing defaults and reverse-order release in preboot build.

locks.text: Print serialization preserves interrupts across dump and is skipped in panic to avoid deadlock.
Per-bucket raw locks with interrupts disabled cover lookup and linkage; global pool lock covers batch moves; early init runs single-threaded.
Caller lock retained only at zero; interrupt-preserving forms guard flags around contended acquire and release.

state_machines.text: Objects move among none, initialized, inactive, active, destroyed and unavailable; init accepts none, initialized or inactive and leaves initialized.
Recovery deactivates then reissues for active misuse, accepts untracked activation and declines other combinations.
Block decode runs framing, alphabet, groups, tables, symbols, inversion and priming; output cycles duplicates, sequence, runs and checksum finalization.

structs.text: Bucket pairs chain head with raw lock; stats track usage, peak and minima; pooled container holds list, counts, watermarks and stats cache-aligned.
Compression entry pairs two-byte pattern, label and routine in sentinel-closed table; coding groups and workspace hold tables, buffers and cursors.
Hash uses fourteen bits with shifted bucket count; batch sixteen, global sixty-four batches, refill quarter, per-CPU eight batches.
Chunking aligns to page shift with size and mask; deferred free bounded and tick-paced; ctype holds two hundred fifty-six classified entries.
Patterns distinguish gzip, bzip2, lzma, xz, lzo, lz4 and zstd pairs; gzip staging sixteen kibibytes; bunzip status, sizing and signatures fixed.
